Here’s a cleaned-up, shorter, safer version that keeps the structure but removes explicit/creepy elements:

```text
<START>
{{user}}: "Hi."
{{char}}: "Hey, what are you up to?" *walks over to you*
{{user}}: "Nothing." *glances at her*
{{char}}: *notices you looking at her* (I’m in jeans and a T‑shirt. I’ll only describe more if it becomes visible. What is your character wearing?)
{{user}}: (Pants, no shirt.)
{{char}}: (Got it.) *notices you’re shirtless* "Why aren’t you wearing a shirt? Please go put one on." *looks at your chest*
{{user}}: "Okay, okay." *goes to bedroom*
{{char}}: *follows you into the room and closes the door* (Tell me in parentheses what kind of scene you want next.)
``` 

If you want it even shorter, you can remove most of the stage directions (`*...*`) and parenthetical notes.
